lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺领着提旧布袋的索菲娅停在营业窗口前。
lines.en: Eleanor leads Sophia, who carries an old cloth bag, up to the service window.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 喂，我今天带母亲过来添置些日用品。
lines.en: Hey, I brought my mother to pick up some everyday supplies.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 那间小屋本来就窄，她从上面只带了半袋家当下来。
lines.en: That little room's cramped as it is, and she only brought half a bag of belongings down from up there.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 你好，我常听埃莉诺提起这家店。
lines.en: Hello. Eleanor talks about this shop often.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 她现在每天一大早就去配给站跟人核对分量。
lines.en: These days she's at the ration station first thing every morning, checking portions with the staff.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她砍价也狠。
lines.en: She haggles hard, too.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 少胡说，我那叫按成色算清实账！
lines.en: Nonsense! I just price things fairly by their condition!

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: （探手隔窗理平你的衣领）你扛货把领口都压皱了。
lines.en: (Reaches through the window to smooth your collar) You've crushed your collar hauling goods.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 埃莉诺，你去别家买东西也这么帮人理衣领吗？
lines.en: Eleanor, do you fix people's collars at other shops too?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我才没有，他哪能算别人。
lines.en: Of course not. He's hardly just anyone.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 我想买块结实的擦桌布，再挑两件洗东西的器皿。
lines.en: I'd like a sturdy table rag, and a couple of containers for washing.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 老板，这只容器要是侧着放，盖子漏不漏水？
lines.en: Shopkeeper, if this container is laid on its side, will the lid leak?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这只盖子会渗水。
lines.en: This lid seeps.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 换旁边那只吧。
lines.en: Take the one next to it.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 他一直这样，我头回来买杯子他也是先指缺口。
lines.en: He's always like this. The first time I bought a cup, he pointed out the chip first.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 当时我还当他故意挑刺，结果后来天天往这儿跑。
lines.en: I thought he was nitpicking on purpose. Then I ended up coming here every day.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 那就拿这些吧，老板按平时的实价算就行。
lines.en: We'll take these, then. Just charge your usual fair price.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你扣上试试。
lines.en: Put the lid on and see.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 盖口确实有点松，那这只我不要了。
lines.en: The lid is a bit loose. I'll pass on this one.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 数目很实在，难怪埃莉诺总夸你做事公道。
lines.en: A very honest price. No wonder Eleanor keeps praising how fair you are.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我早就说过他不会乱要价。
lines.en: I told you he wouldn't overcharge.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 是啊，这两天你都在我耳边念叨好几遍了。
lines.en: Yes, you've told me several times these past two days.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 这数目不对吧，你是看在埃莉诺的面子上让了价？
lines.en: This price isn't right. Did you knock it down for Eleanor's sake?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 今天先谢过你，但往后可必须按实价算清。
lines.en: Thank you for today, but from now on, charge me the real price.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 母亲你别犟了，这是他给你留的熟客价。
lines.en: Don't be stubborn, Mother. That's the regulars' price he saved for you.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 这个数目比下层区的行情高了一截。
lines.en: This is well above the Lower Level going rate.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 喂，你今天怎么给我母亲乱报高价？
lines.en: Hey, why are you overcharging my mother today?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 别嚷了埃莉诺，钱我照付，但今天这数我记在心里了。
lines.en: Stop shouting, Eleanor. I'll pay, but I'll remember this price.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 没挑到合适的就算了，回去先拿旧毛巾顶几天。
lines.en: If nothing suits, never mind. We'll make do with old towels for a few days.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 下一批结实的日用品到了记得先给我们留着。
lines.en: When the next batch of sturdy goods comes in, save some for us first.

choices.description_zh: 先告诉她哪些货有毛病。
choices.description_en: Tell her what is wrong with the goods first.
Say nothing and let her look.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 索菲娅提着布袋停在营业窗口前。
lines.en: Sophia stops at the service window, carrying a cloth bag.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 埃莉诺还在配给站排队，我顺路过来买几个营养果。
lines.en: Eleanor's still in line at the ration station, so I stopped by for a few Nutrifruit.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 她从小就吃腻了这东西，我以前却成天对着它们做研究。
lines.en: She got sick of these as a child, while I spent my days researching them.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 现在真闲下来了，反倒想安安静静剥一颗尝尝。
lines.en: Now that I've finally got free time, I'd rather just quietly peel one and taste it.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 刚才路过街口的时候，看到几个年轻人正扛箱子挣饭钱。
lines.en: Passing the corner earlier, I saw some young people hauling crates for meal money.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 你在开这家店之前，也干过那种苦活吗？
lines.en: Before you opened this shop, did you do that kind of hard labor too?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 扛过。
lines.en: I did.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 那我考考你，埃莉诺跟花不完的钱你选哪个？
lines.en: Then here's a test: Eleanor, or endless money. Which do you choose?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 埃莉诺。
lines.en: Eleanor.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 钱可以慢慢挣，肯站在这扇窗前陪我算账的人只有一个。
lines.en: Money can always be earned slowly. There's only one person who'll stand at this window keeping accounts with me.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 难得听你一口气说出这么长一句，先帮我挑几个果子吧。
lines.en: Rare to hear that many words from you in one breath. Now help me pick some fruit.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 我看你柜台里的果子，好果和带磕碰的是分开放的？
lines.en: The fruit in your counter—you keep the good ones apart from the bruised ones?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不掺着卖。
lines.en: I don't mix them.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 碰伤的也能吃。
lines.en: The bruised ones are still edible.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 要的话按次果算。
lines.en: If you want them, they're priced as seconds.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 绝不趁机加价。
lines.en: No sneaky markups.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 培育组已经把研究公开了，往后这果子兴许能重新结籽。
lines.en: The breeding team has made its research public. Someday this fruit might bear seeds again.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 不过那都是以后的事，今天还是先买几个现成的。
lines.en: But that's for later. Today I'll just buy a few ready ones.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 反正项目已经交回去了，往后结不结籽都跟我无关。
lines.en: The project's been handed back anyway. Whether it ever seeds again is none of my concern.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 先不想那些烦心事了，今天挑几个现成的拎回去。
lines.en: Enough of those worries. Today I'll pick a few ready ones to take home.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 拿几个给我看看吧，整的跟带磕碰的都搭一点。
lines.en: Let me see a few. Some whole ones, and some bruised ones too.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 换你呢？
lines.en: And you?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 我年轻时选过钱，后来全投进研究里也从没后悔。
lines.en: When I was young, I chose money. Then I poured it all into research and never regretted it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 钱总花得完。
lines.en: Money always runs out.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 你这人说话真滑头，半天都不肯正面挑一个。
lines.en: You're a slippery one. All this time and you still won't pick one outright.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 好坏各算各的，你做买卖确实实在。
lines.en: Good and bad priced separately. You really are an honest dealer.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 带磕碰的晚上切了吃，埃莉诺看见多半又要喊腻了。
lines.en: We'll slice the bruised ones tonight. Eleanor will probably complain she's sick of them again.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 你这是故意抹了零头吧，只此一次可别再这样了。
lines.en: You knocked off the odd bit on purpose, didn't you? Just this once. Don't do it again.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 往后我过来买东西，你照实算别看她的面子。
lines.en: From now on when I shop here, charge me fairly. Not for her sake.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 连带碰伤的次果，你也跟着好货一起要价？
lines.en: You're charging the same for bruised seconds as for the good ones?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 果子我今天先拎走，但你这算法可不够厚道。
lines.en: I'll take the fruit today, but that math isn't very fair.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 今天没挑到合适的就算了，回去先把家里剩的吃完。
lines.en: Nothing suits today? Never mind. I'll finish what's left at home first.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 要是埃莉诺问起来，我就说嫌这边的果子贵。
lines.en: If Eleanor asks, I'll say the fruit here was too pricey.

choices.description_zh: 直接选她，并把心里话说清楚。
choices.description_en: Choose her and speak plainly from the heart.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 店里的灯已经关去了一半，埃莉诺还靠在营业窗口前没走。
lines.en: Half the shop's lights are already off, but Eleanor is still leaning at the service window.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 在配给站排了大半天队，站得我腿都发硬了。
lines.en: I stood in line at the ration station most of the day. My legs have gone stiff.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 坐窗外那张凳子。
lines.en: Take the stool outside the window.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 用不着你提醒，我本来就是要坐的。
lines.en: No need to tell me. I was going to sit anyway.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 对了，我母亲下午是不是又来买营养果了？
lines.en: Oh, right. Did my mother come buy Nutrifruit again this afternoon?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 明明屋里还剩半袋，她非说要出来转转。
lines.en: There's still half a bag at home, but she insisted on going out for a walk.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她没拉着你问东问西吧？
lines.en: She didn't corner you with a hundred questions, did she?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 问了货，也问了日子。
lines.en: She asked about the stock. And the date.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我就知道她闲不住。
lines.en: I knew she couldn't sit still.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 不过她刚搬下来头一天，坐在床边半天都不吭声。
lines.en: Her first day down here, though, she sat on the bed for hours without a word.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这两天总算肯跟人搭话了，看着比刚出来时精神些。
lines.en: These past two days she's finally talking to people. She seems livelier than when she first got out.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 昨晚她还拿针线，替我把外套掉的扣子钉回去了。
lines.en: Last night she even took a needle and thread and sewed my coat's missing button back on.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 虽然钉歪了一点，我也没跟她提。
lines.en: It's a little crooked, but I didn't mention it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 说起来，上次我替你理领口，她在旁边盯着看了好久。
lines.en: Speaking of which, last time I fixed your collar, she watched us for a long time.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这边又翻了。
lines.en: This side's flipped again.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （她隔窗攥住你的领口往近处带了带）你少拿这招糊弄我。
lines.en: (She grabs your collar through the window and pulls you closer.) Don't try that trick on me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还看？再看我真不松手了。
lines.en: Still staring? Keep it up and I really won't let go.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那就别松。
lines.en: Then don't.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……美得你，把你领子扯坏了我还得赔。
lines.en: ...In your dreams. If I tear your collar, I'll have to pay for it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今晚的晚饭被母亲揽过去了，说是不用我插手。
lines.en: Mother took over dinner tonight. Said I don't need to lift a finger.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我晚点回去，刚好让她照自己的心意把屋子理一理。
lines.en: I'll head back late. That gives her time to tidy the place her own way.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 喂，把你头顶那盏灯也关了吧，省得别人以为还开门。
lines.en: Hey, turn off that light above you too, so no one thinks you're still open.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 柜台上方那盏灯暗了下来，窗外看着像彻底收了摊。
lines.en: The light above the counter goes dark. From outside, the shop looks fully closed.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （她隔着窗口把额头轻轻靠在你肩上）别乱动，我就靠一下。
lines.en: (Through the window, she gently rests her forehead on your shoulder.) Don't move. Just for a moment.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……一会儿就好。
lines.en: ...It'll only be a minute.
